name: Bicep: public network exposure
attack_scenario: an unauthenticated attacker on the internet enumerates the public endpoint and reads blob data or connects to the database directly, bypassing every network control the VNet was supposed to provide
negative_test_hint: set "publicNetworkAccess: 'Enabled'" on the storage account and assert the template is rejected in favor of Disabled with a deny-by-default network ACL

exemplar.explanation: allowBlobPublicAccess:true permits anonymous blob reads; publicNetworkAccess:'Enabled' and defaultAction:'Allow' open the resource to the whole internet; a firewall rule with startIpAddress '0.0.0.0' whitelists every source. Secure defaults are Disabled/Deny with explicit allow-lists so only intended networks can reach the resource.
